estimator.riskTarget: catastrophic (regret >= 100) in at least one member world of the public-equivalence class

uncertainty.statement: upper bound = mean + z x standard deviation across bags, each bag fit on a bootstrap of origin families, plus a fixed penalty per numeric feature outside the development envelope

qualification.statement: Development model under R0. It is not qualified for control or dispatch. Its measured DEV performance is in the SK1 result record; no finite DEV result proves universal safety.
